meta.summary: A damped pendulum $x' = y$, $y' = -\sin x - 0.3y$ from three starts, spiralling into rest.

mkp-math:ode@1.name: ode
mkp-math:ode@1.about: Trajectories of the system x' = f(x, y), y' = g(x, y) from start points you drag, integrated by RK4 over the direction field.

inputs.name: time
inputs.about: how long to follow each trajectory

inputs.name: a
inputs.about: where the first start point begins

inputs.name: back
inputs.about: also follow each trajectory backwards in time

values.name: rk2
values.body: rk3(p, k1, k2, k3, v(add(p, k3, 1), k))

values.name: rk4
values.body: if(abs(p.x - (xmin + xmax)/2) > 4 span or abs(p.y - (ymin + ymax)/2) > 4 span, p, rk(p, k, v(p, k), v(add(p, v(p, k), 0.5), k)))
comment: one classical Runge–Kutta step of size k; a point far outside the view stops moving, which ends the scan

values.name: whole
values.body: if(back, reverse(path(p, -h)) + path(p, h), path(p, h))

values.name: now
comment: where each start point has got to at time s

values.name: dirn
values.body: add(q, v(q, 1), sg 0.38 min(hx, hy)/max(sqrt(f(q.x, q.y)^2 + g(q.x, q.y)^2), 0.000000001))
comment: a short direction mark through a grid point

label.text: Trajectories of the system from start points you can drag
